requirements: R1: Implement LTI launch protocol handler to authenticate Moodle sessions.

slices.title: Add LTI launch parameter authentication to Moodle SSO
slices.jtbd: When implementing the LTI protocol handler for this epic, I want to process Moodle launch requests, so that users can seamlessly access the application without a separate login.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an LTI launch request from Moodle with valid launch parameters and signature
When received by the authentication controller
Then the system authenticates the user, synchronizes their role and department, returns a valid session token, and automated tests verify successful and failed LTI launches.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Authentication success rate for LTI requests

requirements: R1: Create API endpoint POST /api/v1/auth/moodle/override-role to manage role hierarchy mappings.

slices.title: Implement Moodle role override endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing the role override endpoint for this epic, I want to process role adjustment requests, so that administrators can configure Moodle role mappings from the UI.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated administrator
When requesting Moodle role hierarchy mappings or submitting a role override via /api/v1/auth/moodle/override-role
Then the system returns the current role hierarchy mapping and updates the user role, and integration tests confirm proper access control and data updates.
